task_instance: Run the hunt-regressions stage on one pinned change: review a frozen diff (sample early-return auth bypass added to verify_token), trace changed behavior to callers, record candidate regression leads, reserve each candidate's ID via the bundled registry.py, and write/seal the candidate files and hunt.json that the skill specifies as its deliverable.
blocker_detail: The skill's deliverable is not plain text: step 4 of SKILL.md requires reserving each candidate ID by invoking the bundled registry helper (candidate command) via 'uv run --no-project', and the file contract requires sealing/verifying the candidate files and hunt.json via the bundled evidence helper (seal/verify). Both are Python programs that acquire POSIX file locks and own registry.json, so they must be executed. This office-assistant runtime cannot run code or shell commands of any kind, so the candidate IDs cannot be reserved and the hunt.json package cannot be sealed or verified. The helper scripts exist beside the skill (present, not missing), so the blocker is the inability to execute them, not absent skill files. Additionally the stage requires a 'sealed preparation, frozen S0/S1' input produced by the separate prepare stage, which likewise needs code execution. I was told not to write a replacement/stub for the bundled scripts or fabricate their output. I could only produce the free-text discovery analysis of candidate leads, not the reserved-and-sealed deliverable.
evidence: Read SKILL.md and references/evidence.md and scripts/registry.py from the installed skill. registry.py is an argparse CLI (commands init/reserve/bind/candidate/retry/check/accept/show) requiring 'uv run --no-project', fcntl POSIX locks (import fcntl, fcntl.flock) and atomic writes to registry.json; the candidate() function is the only way to allocate a stable candidate ID, and evidence.py seal/verify is the only way to seal hunt.json. None can be invoked without code execution. Produced sample input at sample/change-1.diff and a text-only lead analysis at attempt/candidate-analysis.md to show the attempt; no reserved candidate IDs, no registry.json, and no sealed hunt.json could be created because running the bundled scripts is impossible in this runtime.
